# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility module for rendering user profiles safely for web display. """ from html import escape from typing import Final # Template used to format the user profile. The placeholders are named # {username}, {bio} and {status_message}. Adjust the template as needed. PROFILE_FORMAT: Final[str] = ( "
" "

{username}

" "

{bio}

" "
Status: {status_message}
" "
" ) def render_user_profile(username: str, bio: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as they entered it. bio : str A user-written biography that may span multiple sentences. status_message : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The profile HTML string with all user-provided data safely escaped. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the arguments are not strings. """ if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, bio, status_message)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_username = escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = escape(bio, quote=False) # keep quotes to preserve formatting safe_status = escape(status_message, quote=True) return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status )
